Executive recap (high level)
1) Business outcomes / goals
- Goal: Deploy Redwood inference to power clinical note summarization and triage workflows across 12k providers; target 40% reduction in manual triage time and 25% faster physician turnaround for documentation.
- Expected initial scope: 3 production models, phased rollout across 4 regions (pilot in West region)
- Impact: projected 6-9 month payback driven by provider time savings and reduced transcription costs.

2) Primary pain points
- Latency spikes during peak hours impacting user workflows
- High per-token costs on current vendor + unpredictable overage charges
- Security/compliance constraints (data residency, audit logs, need for SOC2 artifacts)

3) Proposed Redwood approach & mitigation of risk
- Serving: Dedicated instance for NovaHealth with pinned model versions and predictable throughput (SLA targets: p95 latency < 300ms for 512-token requests)
- Cost controls: batching + prefix caching recommendations and quantization profiles to reduce token costs ~30-40% vs baseline
- Compliance: support for VPC/private deployment, KMS integration, and audit logs; attached SOC2 summary and sample SOW for Legal

4) Procurement path & timeline (recommended)
- Week 0: Exec approval + confirm procurement lead (you)
- Week 1-2: Legal reviews sample SOW & contract redlines (we’ll provide a tracked redline)
- Week 2-3: PO issuance and reserved capacity provisioning (Dedicated)
- Week 4-6: Pilot deployment and integration support (success metrics: latency, throughput, cost per inference)

5) Escalation items
- If SOC2 evidence or additional security controls are required, escalate to Redwood Security (security@redwood.com) for an SOC2 packet and technical workshops
- If procurement requires custom SLA or pricing, we’ll route to Sales Leadership for approval (Deal ID: RDW-NOVA-2027-045)

Attachments included (PDF/XLSX/DOCX stubs):
- Redwood-Exec-Recap-NovaHealth.pdf (this email’s one-pager)
- SOC2-Summary.pdf (controls overview)
- Pricing-Breakdown-NovaHealth.xlsx (cost scenarios: pilot, steady-state, enterprise)
- SOW-Template.docx (sample statement of work)

Related links:

- DocuSign (sample contract route): https://www.docusign.com/complete/abc12345

- Laura / Aditya: I’ve CC’d you for visibility — Laura, can you prep a short CFO-facing one-pager with expected cost savings and simple $-impact? Aditya, please standby for any pricing adjustments if Legal requests custom terms.

Thanks — happy to adjust the recap if you want a shorter exec-summary version.
